title: 真心话大冒险
htmlContent:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover" />
  <title>真心话大冒险 · 恋人牌局</title>
  <style>
    :root {
      /* ===== 日间模式（默认）===== */
      --bg-1: #fdf6f0;
      --bg-2: #faf0e6;
      --panel: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
      --panel-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      --glass-border: rgba(180, 140, 120, 0.18);
      --glass-shadow: rgba(180, 140, 100, 0.12);
      --text-1: #3d2c1e;
      --text-2: #8a7060;
      --text-3: #b8a090;
      --brand-1: #e8a4b8;
      --brand-2: #c88fa8;
      --accent: #d4849c;
      --ok: #7bc8a4;
      --warn: #e8b86d;
      --danger: #e07070;
      --zone-daily-1: #88c8d8;
      --zone-daily-2: #6bb8cc;
      --zone-love-1: #e8a0b4;
      --zone-love-2: #d88ca0;
      --zone-erotic-1: #b8a0d4;
      --zone-erotic-2: #a088c4;
      --card-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.65);
      --card-face: #fff8f4;
      --card-back: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8a4b8 0%, #c0a0d0 50%, #88b8d0 100%);
      --card-back-pattern: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
      --blob-1: #fce4ec;
      --blob-2: #f3e5f5;
      --blob-3: #e8eaf6;
      --body-bg: #fdf6f0;
      --dice-face-bg: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff8f4, #f0e8e0);
      --dice-pip: #5a3e30;
      --modal-bg: rgba(253, 246, 240, 0.95);
      --toast-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
      --theme-icon: '🌙';
      --float-heart-opacity: 0.08;
    }

    /* ===== 夜间模式 ===== */
    .dark {
      --bg-1: #1a1420;
      --bg-2: #201828;
      --panel: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      --panel-strong: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
      --glass-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.10);
      --glass-shadow: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
      --text-1: #ece4e0;
      --text-2: #a898a0;
      --text-3: #786870;
      --brand-1: #d88ca8;
      --brand-2: #b878a0;
      --accent: #c47898;
      --ok: #5cb890;
      --warn: #d4a050;
      --danger: #d06060;
      --zone-daily-1: #60a8b8;
      --zone-daily-2: #5098ac;
      --zone-love-1: #c88098;
      --zone-love-2: #b87088;
      --zone-erotic-1: #9880b8;
      --zone-erotic-2: #8870a8;
      --card-bg: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
      --card-face: #2a2030;
      --card-back: linear-gradient(135deg, #c47898 0%, #9878b0 50%, #6898a8 100%);
      --card-back-pattern: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06);
      --blob-1: rgba(200, 120, 160, 0.12);
      --blob-2: rgba(160, 120, 200, 0.10);
      --blob-3: rgba(120, 160, 200, 0.08);
      --body-bg: #1a1420;
      --dice-face-bg: linear-gradient(180deg, #3a2e40, #2a2030);
      --dice-pip: #e8d8d0;
      --modal-bg: rgba(26, 20, 32, 0.95);
      --toast-bg: rgba(40, 30, 48, 0.9);
      --theme-icon: '☀️';
      --float-heart-opacity: 0.04;
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
    html {
      width: 100%; height: 100%;
      min-height: 100vh;
      min-height: -webkit-fill-available;
      background: var(--body-bg);
      transition: background 0.5s ease;
    }
    html.dark {
      background: var(--body-bg);
    }
    body {
      width: 100vw; height: 100vh;
      height: -webkit-fill-available;
      min-height: 100vh;
      min-height: -webkit-fill-available;
      overflow-x: hidden;
      overflow-y: auto;
      margin: 0; padding: 0;
      font-family: ui-rounded, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif;
      color: var(--text-1);
      background: var(--body-bg);
      padding-top: max(44px, env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px));
      padding-bottom: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 16px));
      padding-left: env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px);
      padding-right: env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px);
      overscroll-behavior: none;
      -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
      transition: background 0.5s ease, color 0.3s ease;
    }

    /* 移动端适配 + iOS安全区 */
    @supports (padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top)) {
      body {
        padding-top: max(40px, env(safe-area-inset-top));
        padding-bottom: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
      }
    }

    /* ===== 实化背景装饰 ===== */
    .bg-pattern {
      position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 50% at 15% 10%, rgba(252,228,236,0.7) 0%, transparent 70%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 60% at 85% 80%, rgba(243,229,245,0.6) 0%, transparent 70%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 40% 40% at 50% 50%, rgba(232,234,246,0.4) 0%, transparent 60%),
        repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent, transparent 60px, rgba(232,164,184,0.03) 60px, rgba(232,164,184,0.03) 61px),
        repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, transparent, transparent 60px, rgba(184,160,212,0.03) 60px, rgba(184,160,212,0.03) 61px);
    }
    .dark .bg-pattern {
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 50% at 15% 10%, rgba(36,24,40,0.8) 0%, transparent 70%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 60% at 85% 80%, rgba(32,24,48,0.7) 0%, transparent 70%),
        repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent, transparent 60px, rgba(200,120,160,0.02) 60px, rgba(200,120,160,0.02) 61px);
    }
    /* 顶部装饰条 */
    .bg-top-strip {
      position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 200px;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(232,164,184,0.12) 0%, transparent 100%);
      pointer-events: none; z-index: 0;
    }
    .dark .bg-top-strip {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(200,120,152,0.08) 0%, transparent 100%);
    }
    /* 底部柔光 */
    .bg-bottom-glow {
      position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 180px;
      background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(184,160,212,0.08) 0%, transparent 100%);
      pointer-events: none; z-index: 0;
    }
    .dark .bg-bottom-glow {
      background: linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(100,80,140,0.06) 0%, transparent 100%);
    }
    /* 散点装饰 */
    .bg-dots {
      position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; z-index: 0;
      background-image: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(232,164,184,0.15) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 32px 32px;
    }
    .dark .bg-dots {
      background-image: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(200,120,160,0.06) 1px, transparent 1px);
    }

    /* 浮动爱心装饰 */
    .decor { position: fixed; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden; z-index: 1; }
    .float-heart {
      position: absolute; font-size: 20px; opacity: var(--float-heart-opacity);
      animation: floatHeart 18s infinite ease-in-out;
    }
    @keyframes floatHeart {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg) scale(1); }
      25% { transform: translateY(-30px) rotate(10deg) scale(1.1); }
      50% { transform: translateY(-15px) rotate(-5deg) scale(0.95); }
      75% { transform: translateY(-40px) rotate(8deg) scale(1.05); }
    }
    .blob { position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; filter: blur(40px); }
    .b1 { width: 40vh; height: 40vh; left: -12vh; top: -8vh; background: var(--blob-1); opacity: 0.35; }
    .b2 { width: 34vh; height: 34vh; right: -10vh; top: 5vh; background: var(--blob-2); opacity: 0.3; }
    .b3 { width: 36vh; height: 36vh; left: 12vw; bottom: -14vh; background: var(--blob-3); opacity: 0.3; }

    /* 日夜切换按钮 */
    .theme-toggle {
      position: fixed; bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) + 20px); right: 16px;
      width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      background: var(--panel); backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 20px; z-index: 15;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px var(--glass-shadow);
      transition: transform 0.3s ease, background 0.3s ease;
    }
    .theme-toggle:active { transform: scale(0.9); }

    /* 主容器 */
    #ui {
      position: relative; z-index: 2; width: 100%; min-height: 100%;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
      gap: 12px; padding: 18px 16px 80px;
      overflow-x: hidden; overflow-y: auto;
      overscroll-behavior-x: none;
      touch-action: pan-y;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      scrollbar-width: none; -ms-overflow-style: none;
    }
    #ui::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

    .header {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
      padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 999px;
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px); background: var(--panel-strong);
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 24px var(--glass-shadow), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    }
    .avatar {
      width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover;
      background: var(--panel); border: 2px solid var(--brand-1);
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    }
    .name {
      font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-2);
      max-width: 80px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;
    }
    .heart-dot {
      font-size: 14px; animation: heartbeat 1.5s infinite ease-in-out;
    }
    @keyframes heartbeat {
      0%, 100% { transform: scale(1); }
      50% { transform: scale(1.25); }
    }

    .title {
      margin-top: 2px; text-align: center;
      font-size: 22px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: 3px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand-1), var(--accent), var(--brand-2));
      -webkit-background-clip: text; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
    }
    .subtitle { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-2); opacity: .85; letter-spacing: 1px; text-align: center; }

    /* 视图切换 */
    .view { display: none; width: min(92vw, 480px); }
    .view.active { display: block; animation: fadeSlideIn 0.4s ease; }
    @keyframes fadeSlideIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    /* 通用卡片 */
    .card {
      position: relative; width: 100%; min-height: 120px; margin-top: 6px;
      padding: 18px; border-radius: 20px;
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      background: var(--card-bg);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.1);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(1.1);
      box-shadow: 0 8px 32px var(--glass-shadow);
    }
    .section-title {
      font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      color: var(--text-1); margin-bottom: 10px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    }
    .hint { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-2); opacity: .85; line-height: 1.5; }

    /* 操作按钮 */
    .actions { margin-top: 14px; width: 100%; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }
    .btn {
      padding: 12px 14px; border: none; border-radius: 14px;
      cursor: pointer; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px;
      color: #fff;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand-1), var(--brand-2));
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.08), 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
      transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, filter 0.2s ease;
      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .btn::after {
      content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 0%, transparent 60%);
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    .btn:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.97); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); }
    .btn.primary { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand-1), var(--brand-2)); }
    .btn.secondary { color: var(--text-1); background: var(--panel-strong); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); }
    .btn.secondary::after { background: none; }
    .btn.ghost { color: var(--text-2); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); }
    .btn.ghost::after { background: none; }
    .btn.warn { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8b86d, #d4a050); }
    .btn.success { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--ok), #5cb890); }
    .btn.danger { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--danger), #c05050); }
    .btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; filter: grayscale(0.3); }

    /* 角色选择 */
    .center { text-align: center; }
    .role-emoji { font-size: 40px; margin-bottom: 8px; }

    /* 题库选择 */
    .zone-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; }
    .zone {
      position: relative; padding: 14px 10px; border-radius: 16px;
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      background: var(--panel); backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
      cursor: pointer; text-align: center;
      transition: transform 0.12s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease;
    }
    .zone:active { transform: scale(0.97); }
    .zone.active { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 4px 20px var(--glass-shadow); }
    .zone.active::after {
      content: '✓'; position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 8px;
      font-size: 11px; color: #fff; width: 18px; height: 18px;
      border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent);
      display: grid; place-items: center; font-weight: 900;
    }
    .zone[data-zone="日常区"].active { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(136,200,216,0.2), rgba(136,200,216,0.05)); }
    .zone[data-zone="情欲区"].active { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(232,160,180,0.2), rgba(232,160,180,0.05)); }
    .zone[data-zone="爱欲区"].active { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(184,160,212,0.2), rgba(184,160,212,0.05)); }
    .zone h4 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-1); }
    .zone .zone-emoji { font-size: 22px; display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; }
    .zone p { margin: 0; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-2); line-height: 1.4; }
    .badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px; font-size: 10px; padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--danger); color: #fff; }

    .switch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 12px; }
    .toggle {
      width: 44px; height: 24px; border-radius: 999px; position: relative;
      background: var(--panel-strong); border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); cursor: pointer;
    }
    .toggle::after {
      content: ''; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px;
      width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--text-2); transition: left 0.2s ease, background 0.2s ease;
    }
    .toggle.on { background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand-1), var(--brand-2)); }
    .toggle.on::after { left: 23px; background: #fff; }

    .deck-list { margin-top: 10px; display: grid; gap: 6px; max-height: 140px; overflow-y: auto; }
    .deck-item {
      padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--panel);
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-2);
    }

    /* 提示词预览 */
    .prompt-preview {
      margin-top: 10px; padding: 10px; border-radius: 12px;
      background: var(--panel); border: 1px dashed var(--glass-border);
      font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-3); line-height: 1.5;
      max-height: 80px; overflow-y: auto; display: none;
    }
    .prompt-preview.show { display: block; }

    /* 掷骰（3D） */
    .dice-wrap { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 20px; align-items: center; justify-items: center; }
    .dice-player-label { font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-2); font-weight: 600; margin-top: 6px; }
    .scene { width: 88px; height: 88px; perspective: 900px; }
    .dice3d { width: 88px; height: 88px; position: relative; }
    .cube { width: 100%; height: 100%; position: relative; transform-style: preserve-3d; transition: transform 1.1s cubic-bezier(.22,.9,.26,1); }
    .face {
      position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background: var(--dice-face-bg);
      border-radius: 14px;
      box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.3), 0 4px 16px var(--glass-shadow);
      display: grid; place-items: center;
    }
    .pip {
      width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--dice-pip);
      box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    }
    .face.one   { transform: rotateY(0deg) translateZ(44px); }
    .face.two   { transform: rotateX(-90deg) translateZ(44px); }
    .face.three { transform: rotateY(90deg) translateZ(44px); }
    .face.four  { transform: rotateY(-90deg) translateZ(44px); }
    .face.five  { transform: rotateX(90deg) translateZ(44px); }
    .face.six   { transform: rotateY(180deg) translateZ(44px); }
    .pips { position: relative; width: 68%; height: 68%; }
    .pips .p { position: absolute; }
    .p.c  { top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); }
    .p.tl { top: 8%;  left: 8%;  }
    .p.tr { top: 8%;  right: 8%; }
    .p.bl { bottom: 8%; left: 8%;  }
    .p.br { bottom: 8%; right: 8%; }
    .p.ml { top: 50%; left: 8%;  transform: translateY(-50%); }
    .p.mr { top: 50%; right: 8%; transform: translateY(-50%); }
    .vs-badge {
      font-weight: 900; font-size: 16px; text-align: center;
      color: var(--accent); letter-spacing: 2px; margin: 4px 0;
    }
    .result { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; text-align: center; color: var(--text-1); }

    /* ===== 抽卡：卡牌 UI ===== */
    .draw-stage { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }

    /* 卡牌容器 */
    .card-spread {
      display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 0;
      perspective: 1000px; padding: 16px 0;
      position: relative; min-height: 200px;
    }
    .game-card {
      width: 110px; height: 160px;
      position: relative;
      cursor: pointer;
      transform-style: preserve-3d;
      transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1), margin 0.3s ease;
      border-radius: 14px;
    }
    @media (hover: hover) {
    .game-card:hover { transform: translateY(-12px) rotateY(0deg); z-index: 5; }
    }
    /* 扇形排列 */
    .game-card:nth-child(1) { transform: rotate(-12deg) translateY(8px); margin-right: -20px; }
    .game-card:nth-child(2) { transform: rotate(-6deg) translateY(2px); margin-right: -20px; }
    .game-card:nth-child(3) { transform: rotate(0deg); margin-right: -20px; }
    .game-card:nth-child(4) { transform: rotate(6deg) translateY(2px); margin-right: -20px; }
    .game-card:nth-child(5) { transform: rotate(12deg) translateY(8px); }

    @media (hover: hover) {
    .game-card:hover { z-index: 10; }
    .game-card:nth-child(1):hover { transform: rotate(-12deg) translateY(-12px) scale(1.05); }
    .game-card:nth-child(2):hover { transform: rotate(-6deg) translateY(-12px) scale(1.05); }
    .game-card:nth-child(3):hover { transform: translateY(-12px) scale(1.05); }
    .game-card:nth-child(4):hover { transform: rotate(6deg) translateY(-12px) scale(1.05); }
    .game-card:nth-child(5):hover { transform: rotate(12deg) translateY(-12px) scale(1.05); }
    }
    /* 移动端点击反馈 */
    @media (hover: none) {
    .game-card:active { transform: translateY(-8px) scale(1.03); z-index: 10; transition: transform 0.15s ease; }
    }

    .card-inner {
      width: 100%; height: 100%;
      position: relative;
      transform-style: preserve-3d;
      transition: transform 0.7s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
    }
    .game-card.flipped .card-inner { transform: rotateY(180deg); }

    .card-front, .card-back-face {
      position: absolute; inset: 0;
      border-radius: 14px;
      backface-visibility: hidden;
      -webkit-backface-visibility: hidden;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      padding: 10px;
    }
    .card-back-face {
      background: var(--card-back);
      border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 24px var(--glass-shadow), inset 0 0 30px var(--card-back-pattern), 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .card-back-face::before {
      content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 7px;
      border: 1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      border-radius: 9px;
      background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, transparent, transparent 4px, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 4px, rgba(255,255,255,0.04) 8px);
    }
    .card-back-face::after {
      content: '✦'; position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 10px;
      font-size: 10px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3);
    }
    .card-back-face .back-icon {
      font-size: 32px; opacity: 0.9;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.15));
      animation: gentlePulse 2.5s infinite ease-in-out;
    }
    @keyframes gentlePulse {
      0%, 100% { transform: scale(1) rotate(0deg); }
      25% { transform: scale(1.06) rotate(3deg); }
      50% { transform: scale(1.1) rotate(0deg); }
      75% { transform: scale(1.06) rotate(-3deg); }
    }
    .card-back-face .back-text {
      font-size: 10px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
      margin-top: 6px; letter-spacing: 2px; font-weight: 600;
      text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    }

    .card-front {
      background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--card-face) 0%, rgba(255,240,245,0.95) 100%);
      border: 2px solid var(--glass-border);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 24px var(--glass-shadow), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
      transform: rotateY(180deg);
      gap: 8px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .card-front::before {
      content: ''; position: absolute; top: -20px; right: -20px;
      width: 50px; height: 50px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(232,164,184,0.15) 0%, transparent 70%);
    }
    .card-front .card-type-badge {
      padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; color: #fff;
    }
    .card-type-badge.truth { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e8a0b4, #d88ca0); }
    .card-type-badge.dare  { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #88c8d8, #6bb8cc); }
    .card-front .card-text {
      font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-1); text-align: center;
      line-height: 1.5; padding: 0 4px;
    }
    .card-front .card-deck-name {
      font-size: 10px; color: var(--text-3); margin-top: auto;
    }

    /* 选中卡牌放大展示 */
    .chosen-card-display {
      display: none; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
      gap: 14px; animation: cardReveal 0.6s ease;
    }
    .chosen-card-display.show { display: flex; }
    @keyframes cardReveal {
      0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.6) rotateY(90deg); }
      50% { transform: scale(1.05) rotateY(0deg); }
      100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) rotateY(0deg); }
    }
    .chosen-card-big {
      width: 200px; min-height: 260px; border-radius: 20px;
      background: var(--card-face); border: 2px solid var(--glass-border);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 40px var(--glass-shadow);
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center;
      justify-content: center; padding: 20px; gap: 10px;
      position: relative; overflow: hidden;
    }
    .chosen-card-big::before {
      content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 40%, rgba(232,164,184,0.06) 60%, transparent 80%);
    }
    .chosen-card-big .card-type-badge { font-size: 13px; padding: 4px 14px; }
    .chosen-card-big .card-text { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; }
    .chosen-card-big .card-deck-name { font-size: 11px; }


    /* 轻提示 */
    .toast {
      position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) + 70px);
      transform: translate(-50%, 12px); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
      background: var(--toast-bg); color: var(--text-1);
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 999px;
      font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px var(--glass-shadow);
      transition: opacity .25s ease, transform .25s ease; z-index: 10;
      backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
    }
    .toast.show { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, 0); }

    /* 声明/帮助 */
    .footer { font-size: 12px; opacity: .8; text-align: center; margin-top: 6px; color: var(--text-2); }
    .link { text-decoration: underline; cursor: pointer; opacity: 0.8; }
    .modal { position: fixed; inset: 0; display: none; place-items: center; background: rgba(0,0,0,.3); z-index: 20; }
    .modal.on { display: grid; }
    .modal-card {
      width: min(88vw, 400px); background: var(--modal-bg); color: var(--text-1);
      border-radius: 20px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 12px 40px var(--glass-shadow);
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border); backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    }
    .modal-card h3 { margin: 4px 0 10px; font-size: 17px; }
    .modal-card p { margin: 6px 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--text-2); }

    /* 过渡动画 */
    .fade-enter { animation: fadeSlideIn 0.4s ease; }

    /* 提示词提示卡片 */
    .prompt-tip {
      margin-top: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 12px;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(232,164,184,0.08), rgba(184,160,212,0.08));
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-2); line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .prompt-tip strong { color: var(--text-1); }

    /* ===== 聊天对话区域 ===== */
    .chat-area {
      margin-top: 14px;
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0;
      width: 100%;
    }

    /* 用户回答输入区域 - 仿微信/QQ输入栏 */
    .player-answer-area {
      margin-top: 14px; padding: 14px 12px;
      background: var(--panel-strong);
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      border-radius: 18px;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 20px var(--glass-shadow);
      backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
      display: none; animation: fadeSlideIn 0.4s ease;
    }
    .player-answer-area.show { display: block; }
    .player-answer-label {
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 12px;
      font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-1); font-weight: 800;
      padding: 0 4px; letter-spacing: 0.5px;
    }
    .player-answer-label .label-icon { font-size: 18px; }
    .answer-input-row {
      display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 10px;
    }
    .answer-textarea {
      width: 100%; min-height: 42px; max-height: 120px; padding: 10px 18px;
      border-radius: 16px; border: 1.5px solid var(--glass-border);
      background: var(--card-face); color: var(--text-1);
      font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; resize: none;
      font-family: inherit;
      outline: none !important;
      -webkit-outline: none !important;
      -webkit-appearance: none; appearance: none;
      -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
      -webkit-focus-ring-color: transparent;
      transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
    }
    .answer-textarea::placeholder { color: var(--text-3); }
    .answer-textarea:focus,
    .answer-textarea:active {
      outline: none !important;
      outline-width: 0 !important;
      outline-style: none !important;
      outline-color: transparent !important;
      border-color: var(--accent);
      box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(212, 132, 156, 0.15);
      background: var(--card-face);
    }
    /* 键盘弹出时输入框适配 */
    @media (max-height: 500px) {
      .player-answer-area {
        position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
        z-index: 100; border-radius: 18px 18px 0 0;
        margin: 0; padding: 10px 12px;
        max-height: 50vh; overflow-y: auto;
      }
    }
    /* 回答按钮组 */
    .answer-actions {
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 12px;
      margin-top: 12px;
    }
    .answer-actions .btn {
      flex: 1; max-width: 160px; padding: 10px 20px;
      border-radius: 999px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.5px;
      transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, filter 0.2s ease;
    }
    .answer-actions .btn.ghost {
      background: var(--panel-strong);
      border: 1.5px solid var(--glass-border);
      color: var(--text-2);
      backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    }
    .answer-actions .btn.ghost:hover {
      background: var(--panel);
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--accent);
    }
    .answer-actions .btn.primary {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand-1), var(--accent));
      color: #fff;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(232, 164, 184, 0.35);
    }
    .answer-actions .btn.primary:hover {
      box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(232, 164, 184, 0.45);
      filter: brightness(1.05);
    }
    .answer-actions .btn:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.96); }
    .answer-send-btn {
      width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 50%; border: none;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand-1), var(--brand-2));
      color: #fff; font-size: 18px; cursor: pointer;
      display: grid; place-items: center; flex-shrink: 0;
      box-shadow: 0 3px 12px rgba(232,164,184,0.3);
      transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
    }
    .answer-send-btn:active { transform: scale(0.9); }
    .answer-bottom-row {
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
      margin-top: 8px; padding: 0 4px;
    }
    .answer-hint {
      font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-3); line-height: 1.4; flex: 1;
    }
    .answer-skip-link {
      font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-3); cursor: pointer;
      text-decoration: underline; white-space: nowrap; margin-left: 8px;
      transition: color 0.2s;
    }
    .answer-skip-link:active { color: var(--accent); }

    /* ===== 聊天气泡通用 ===== */
    .chat-msg {
      display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 14px; max-width: 100%;
      animation: msgSlideIn 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
    }
    .chat-msg.hidden { display: none; }
    @keyframes msgSlideIn {
      0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(16px) scale(0.95); }
      100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
    }
    @keyframes bubbleIn {
      0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px) scale(0.9); }
      100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
    }

    /* 头像 */
    .chat-avatar {
      width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0;
      object-fit: cover;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
      border: 2px solid var(--glass-border);
    }
    .chat-msg.right .chat-avatar { border-color: var(--brand-1); }
    .chat-msg.left .chat-avatar { border-color: var(--accent); }

    /* 气泡主体 */
    .chat-bubble-wrap {
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-width: calc(100% - 56px);
    }
    .chat-sender {
      font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 3px; padding: 0 6px;
      color: var(--text-3);
    }
    .chat-bubble {
      position: relative;
      padding: 11px 16px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.65;
      white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-word;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 12px var(--glass-shadow);
      transition: transform 0.2s ease;
    }
    .chat-bubble:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

    /* 用户气泡 (右侧) */
    .chat-msg.right { flex-direction: row-reverse; }
    .chat-msg.right .chat-sender { text-align: right; }
    .chat-msg.right .chat-bubble {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--brand-1), var(--brand-2));
      color: #fff;
      border-radius: 20px 20px 20px 20px;
    }

    /* AI/角色气泡 (左侧) */
    .chat-msg.left .chat-bubble {
      background: var(--panel-strong);
      color: var(--text-1);
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      border-radius: 20px 20px 20px 20px;
    }

    /* 动作描写（斜体，无气泡） */
    .chat-msg .chat-bubble.action-bubble {
      background: none !important;
      border: none !important;
      box-shadow: none !important;
      padding: 4px 8px;
      font-style: italic;
      color: var(--text-2);
      font-size: 13px;
    }

    /* "正在输入中..." 状态栏 */
    .typing-indicator {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 14px; padding: 0 6px;
      animation: msgSlideIn 0.35s ease;
    }
    .typing-indicator.hidden { display: none; }
    .typing-indicator .chat-avatar {
      width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0;
      object-fit: cover;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
      border: 2px solid var(--accent);
    }
    .typing-status {
      display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
      padding: 8px 16px;
      background: var(--panel-strong);
      border: 1px solid var(--glass-border);
      border-radius: 20px;
      box-shadow: 0 2px 12px var(--glass-shadow);
      position: relative;
    }
    .typing-status-text {
      font-size: 13px; color: var(--text-3); font-style: italic;
    }

    /* Loading dots */
    .typing-dots {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 3px;
    }
    .typing-dots span {
      display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--accent);
      animation: typing 1.2s infinite ease-in-out;
    }
    .typing-dots span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
    .typing-dots span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
    @keyframes typing {
      0%, 60%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 0.4; }
      30% { transform: translateY(-6px); opacity: 1; }
    }

    /* 时间戳 */
    .chat-time {
      text-align: center; font-size: 11px; color: var(--text-3);
      margin: 8px 0 14px; opacity: 0.7;
    }
    .chat-time span {
      background: var(--panel); padding: 2px 12px; border-radius: 999px;
      font-weight: 500;
    }

    /* ===== 卡牌星尘粒子特效 ===== */
    .card-particles {
      position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 20px;
    }
    .sparkle {
      position: absolute; width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--brand-1);
      animation: sparkleFloat 2s ease-out forwards;
      opacity: 0;
    }
    @keyframes sparkleFloat {
      0% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); }
      50% { opacity: 0.8; transform: translateY(-30px) scale(1.2); }
      100% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-60px) scale(0); }
    }
    .sparkle:nth-child(odd) { background: var(--accent); }
    .sparkle:nth-child(3n) { background: var(--ok); width: 3px; height: 3px; }
    .sparkle:nth-child(4n) { background: #ffd700; width: 5px; height: 5px; }

    /* ===== 骰子弹跳增强 ===== */
    .cube.rolling {
      animation: diceShake 0.3s ease infinite;
    }
    @keyframes diceShake {
      0%, 100% { transform: rotateX(20deg) rotateY(20deg); }
      25% { transform: rotateX(-20deg) rotateY(40deg) rotateZ(10deg); }
      50% { transform: rotateX(30deg) rotateY(-30deg) rotateZ(-10deg); }
      75% { transform: rotateX(-10deg) rotateY(50deg) rotateZ(5deg); }
    }
    .dice3d.bounce {
      animation: diceBounce 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
    }
    @keyframes diceBounce {
      0% { transform: scale(1); }
      40% { transform: scale(1.15); }
      70% { transform: scale(0.95); }
      100% { transform: scale(1); }
    }

    /* ===== 翻牌星尘爆发 ===== */
    .game-card.flipped .card-inner::after {
      content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -10px;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(232,164,184,0.3) 0%, transparent 70%);
      border-radius: 20px;
      animation: cardGlow 0.8s ease-out forwards;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    @keyframes cardGlow {
      0% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(0.8); }
      100% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.3); }
    }

    /* ===== 选中大卡星尘粒子 ===== */
    .chosen-card-big .card-sparkle-container {
      position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: 20px;
    }

    /* ===== 标题呼吸动效 ===== */
    .title {
      animation: titleBreath 4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    @keyframes titleBreath {
      0%, 100% { filter: brightness(1); }
      50% { filter: brightness(1.15); }
    }

    /* ===== 按钮涟漪效果 ===== */
    .btn-ripple {
      position: absolute; border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
      transform: scale(0);
      animation: ripple 0.6s ease-out forwards;
      pointer-events: none;
    }
    @keyframes ripple {
      to { transform: scale(4); opacity: 0; }
    }

    /* ===== 区域卡片悬浮效果增强 ===== */
    .zone:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 6px 24px var(--glass-shadow);
    }

    /* ===== 骰子结果动画 ===== */
    .result.highlight {
      animation: resultPop 0.5s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1);
      color: var(--accent);
    }
    @keyframes resultPop {
      0% { transform: scale(0.8); opacity: 0; }
      50% { transform: scale(1.1); }
      100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
    }

    /* ===== 选中卡牌持续微粒子 ===== */
    .chosen-card-display.show .chosen-card-big {
      animation: cardFloat 3s ease-in-out infinite;
    }
    @keyframes cardFloat {
      0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); }
      50% { transform: translateY(-6px); }
    }

    /* 旧的兼容隐藏 */
    .player-reply { display: none !important; }
    .char-reply { display: none !important; }
  </style>

  <!-- 实化背景层 -->

      const segments = splitAiText(text);
      const charAvSrc = charAvatarSrc || el('char-avatar').src;
      const chatArea = el('chat-area');

      for (let i = 0; i < segments.length; i++) {
        // 每条消息之前先短暂显示"正在输入中..."
        if (i > 0) {
          showTypingIndicator();
          await delay(600 + Math.random() * 800);
          removeTypingIndicator();
        }

        const segText = segments[i];
        const isAction = /^[（(].*[）)]$/.test(segText.trim()) || /^\*.*\*$/.test(segText.trim());
        const bubbleClass = isAction ? 'chat-bubble action-bubble' : 'chat-bubble';

        const msgDiv = document.createElement('div');
        msgDiv.className = 'chat-msg left';
        const showAvatar = (i === 0); // 只有第一条显示头像和名字，后续紧凑排列
        msgDiv.innerHTML = `
          ${showAvatar
            ? `<img class="chat-avatar" src="${charAvSrc}" alt="${charName}" />`
            : `<div style="width:36px;flex-shrink:0;"></div>`
          }
          <div class="chat-bubble-wrap">
            ${showAvatar ? `<div class="chat-sender">${charName}</div>` : ''}
            <div class="${bubbleClass}">${escapeHtml(segText)}</div>
          </div>
        `;
        chatArea.appendChild(msgDiv);
        scrollChatIntoView(msgDiv);

        // 段间延迟
        if (i < segments.length - 1) {
          await delay(200);
        }
      }
    }

    function escapeHtml(str) {
      const d = document.createElement('div');
      d.textContent = str;
      return d.innerHTML;
    }

    function delay(ms) {
      return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
    }

    function scrollChatIntoView(node) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        node.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'end' });
      }, 80);
    }

    // 温和重绘页面（解决分享后白屏问题）
    function forceRepaint() {
      // 确保当前视图可见
      Object.values(views).forEach(id => el(id).classList.remove('active'));
      el(views[currentView]).classList.add('active');
      if (currentView === 'play') {
        show(el('post-actions'), true);
      }
      // 1) 临时移除 backdrop-filter 避免 WebView 合成层丢失
      const blurEls = document.querySelectorAll('.card, .header, .toast, .modal-card, .player-answer-area, .typing-status');
      blurEls.forEach(e => { e.style.backdropFilter = 'none'; e.style.webkitBackdropFilter = 'none'; });
      // 2) 轻量级重绘，避免display:none导致白屏
      document.body.style.opacity = '0.99';
      void document.body.offsetHeight;
      requestAnimationFrame(() => { document.body.style.opacity = ''; });
      // 3) 滚动归位
      window.scrollTo(0, 0);
      el('ui').scrollTop = 0;
      // 4) 下一帧恢复 backdrop-filter
      requestAnimationFrame(() => {
        requestAnimationFrame(() => {
          blurEls.forEach(e => { e.style.backdropFilter = ''; e.style.webkitBackdropFilter = ''; });
        });
      });
    }

    // 防抖：避免多个事件同时触发 forceRepaint
    let _repaintTimer = null;
    function debouncedRepaint() {
      if (_repaintTimer) clearTimeout(_repaintTimer);
      _repaintTimer = setTimeout(() => {
        _repaintTimer = null;
        forceRepaint();
      }, 150);
    }

        _wasHidden = true;
      } else if (_wasHidden) {
        _wasHidden = false;
        debouncedRepaint();
      }
    });
    window.addEventListener('pageshow', (e) => {
      if (e.persisted) debouncedRepaint();

        submitPlayerAnswer(text).finally(() => {
          btn.disabled = false;
          btn.textContent = '提交回答 💕';
        });
      });
      
      el('skip-answer').addEventListener('click', () => {
        const btn = el('skip-answer');
        if (btn.disabled) return;
        
        btn.disabled = true;
        skipPlayerAnswer().finally(() => {
          btn.disabled = false;
        });
      });

      // 声明弹窗
      el('open-help').addEventListener('click', () => el('help-modal').classList.add('on'));
      el('help-close').addEventListener('click', () => el('help-modal').classList.remove('on'));

      // 年龄确认
      let ageVerified = false;
      el('age-ok')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
        ageVerified = true;
        try { localStorage.setItem('ageVerified18', '1'); } catch (e) { /* sandbox */ }
        el('age-modal')?.classList.remove('on');
        zone = '爱欲区';
        decks = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(BUILTIN[zone] || []));
        extraDecks = [];
        renderZone();
      });
      el('age-cancel')?.addEventListener('click', () => {
        el('age-modal')?.classList.remove('on');
        toast('已取消');
      });
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

title: 大富翁
htmlContent:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover">
    <title>🎩 大富翁 · 白金版</title>
    <style>
        :root {
            --cream: #FFF8F0;
            --gold: #C9A96E;
            --gold-dark: #A0845C;
            --text: #4A3728;
            --text-dim: #8B7355;
            --card: #FFFFFF;
            --border: #E8D5C0;
            --shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(139,115,85,0.12);
            --danger: #D4907A;
            --success: #8BA98B;
            /* 底部操作区+聊天区总高度 */
            --bottom-h: 130px;
        }
        * { margin:0; padding:0; box-sizing:border-box; }

        html, body {
            width: 100%; height: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
            font-family: 'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',system-ui,sans-serif;
            background: linear-gradient(160deg,#FFF8F0 0%,#F5EDE4 40%,#FFF8F0 100%);
            color: var(--text);
            -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
            -webkit-user-select: none;
            user-select: none;
        }

        /* ===== 所有 screen 用 position:fixed 满屏 ===== */
        .screen {
            display: none;
            position: fixed;
            top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
        }
        .screen.active { display: block; }

        /* ===== 设置界面 ===== */
        #setup-screen.active {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            overflow-y: auto;
            -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
            padding: max(100px, env(safe-area-inset-top, 16px)) 16px max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 16px));
        }
        .setup-card {
            background: var(--card); border: 2px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 24px; padding: 22px 18px;
            width: 100%; max-width: 500px;
            box-shadow: var(--shadow); margin-top: 12px; margin-bottom: 20px;
        }
        .setup-card h1 { text-align:center; font-size:26px; color:var(--gold-dark); margin-bottom:2px; letter-spacing:1px; }
        .setup-card .subtitle { text-align:center; color:var(--text-dim); font-size:12px; margin-bottom:18px; }
        .setting-group { margin-bottom:14px; }
        .setting-group label { display:block; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:5px; color:var(--gold-dark); font-size:13px; }
        .setting-group select {
            width:100%; padding:9px 12px; background:var(--cream);
            border:2px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px;
            color:var(--text); font-size:13px; appearance:none;
        }
        .step-card {
            background: var(--cream); border: 2px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 16px; padding: 14px; margin-bottom: 14px;
        }
        .step-title {
            font-size:13px; font-weight:700; color:var(--gold-dark);
            margin-bottom:8px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px;
        }
        .step-title .step-num {
            background:var(--gold); color:#fff; border-radius:50%;
            width:20px; height:20px; display:flex; align-items:center;
            justify-content:center; font-size:11px; font-weight:700; flex-shrink:0;
        }
        .step-hint { font-size:11px; color:var(--text-dim); margin-bottom:8px; }
        .picked-chars-row { display:flex; gap:8px; flex-wrap:wrap; min-height:40px; align-items:center; }
        .picked-char-chip {
            display:flex; align-items:center; gap:5px;
            background:var(--card); border:2px solid var(--gold);
            border-radius:20px; padding:4px 10px 4px 5px; font-size:12px;
        }
        .chip-remove { margin-left:2px; color:var(--text-dim); cursor:pointer; font-size:13px; }
        .char-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:7px; }
        .char-card {
            background:var(--card); border:2px solid var(--border);
            border-radius:12px; padding:10px 4px; text-align:center;
            cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.2s; position:relative;
        }
        .char-card.selected-me { border-color:var(--gold); background:#FFF8EC; box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(201,169,110,0.35); }
        .char-card .c-avatar { font-size:30px; }
        .char-card .c-name { font-size:11px; font-weight:700; margin:3px 0; }
        .char-card .c-trait { font-size:9px; color:var(--text-dim); }
        .char-card .me-badge {
            position:absolute; top:-5px; right:-5px;
            background:var(--gold); color:#fff; border-radius:50%;
            width:18px; height:18px; display:flex; align-items:center;
            justify-content:center; font-size:10px; font-weight:700;
        }
        .btn-pick {
            padding:9px 18px; background:#FFFFFF; color:var(--gold-dark);
            border:2px solid var(--gold); border-radius:20px;
            font-size:13px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer;
        }
        .btn-pick:disabled { opacity:0.5; cursor:not-allowed; }
        .btn-start {
            width:100%; padding:14px;
            background:linear-gradient(135deg,#C9A96E,#A0845C);
            color:#fff; border:none; border-radius:14px;
            font-size:16px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; margin-top:10px;
        }
        .btn-start:disabled { opacity:0.4; cursor:not-allowed; }
        @keyframes popIn { from{transform:scale(0);opacity:0} to{transform:scale(1);opacity:1} }

        /* ===== 选择动画界面 ===== */
        #selection-screen.active {
            display: flex; flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center; justify-content: center;
            overflow-y: auto;
            padding: max(100px, env(safe-area-inset-top, 20px)) 20px 20px;
        }
        .selection-card {
            background:var(--card); border:2px solid var(--border);
            border-radius:22px; padding:26px; width:100%; max-width:460px;
            text-align:center; box-shadow:var(--shadow);
        }
        .sel-status { font-size:15px; color:var(--gold-dark); font-weight:600; margin-bottom:12px; animation:pulse 1.5s infinite; }
        @keyframes pulse { 0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:0.5} }
        .sel-avatars { display:flex; gap:10px; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap; margin:10px 0; }
        .sel-chip {
            background:var(--cream); border:2px solid var(--gold);
            border-radius:14px; padding:10px 8px; text-align:center; min-width:68px;
        }
        .sel-chip .sc-emo { font-size:30px; }
        .sel-chip img { width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:50%; object-fit:cover; }
        .sel-chip .sc-name { font-size:11px; font-weight:700; margin-top:4px; }
        .sel-chip .sc-tag { font-size:9px; color:var(--gold-dark); }
        .sel-log {
            background:var(--cream); border-radius:10px; padding:10px;
            max-height:130px; overflow-y:auto; font-size:11px;
            line-height:1.9; color:var(--text-dim); border:1px solid var(--border); text-align:left;
        }

        /* ===== 游戏界面：固定满屏，flex column ===== */
        #game-screen.active {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            overflow: hidden; /* 整体不滚动 */
        }

        /* 顶部 header：固定高度 */
        .game-header {
            flex-shrink: 0;
            display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
            background: var(--card); border-bottom: 2px solid var(--border);
            padding: max(100px, env(safe-area-inset-top, 8px)) 12px 8px 12px;
            flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px;
        }
        .round-info { font-size:13px; color:var(--gold-dark); font-weight:700; }
        .cur-disp {
            font-size:11px; padding:3px 10px; background:var(--cream);
            border-radius:18px; border:2px solid var(--gold); color:var(--gold-dark); font-weight:600;
        }
        .turn-dots { display:flex; gap:3px; }
        .turn-dot {
            width:24px; height:24px; border-radius:50%;
            display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
            font-size:11px; border:2px solid var(--border); opacity:0.45; transition:all 0.3s;
        }
        .turn-dot.active { border-color:var(--gold); opacity:1; animation:glow 2s infinite; }
        @keyframes glow { 0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 5px rgba(201,169,110,0.3)} 50%{box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(201,169,110,0.7)} }

        /* 中间滚动区：棋盘 + 玩家信息 + 日志，可独立上下滚动 */
        .game-scroll-area {
            flex: 1;
            overflow-y: auto;
            -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
            padding: 8px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 8px;
        }

        /* 棋盘 */
        .board-section {
            background:var(--card); border:2px solid var(--border); border-radius:14px;
            padding:8px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
            box-shadow:var(--shadow); flex-shrink:0;
        }
        #board-container {
            width: min(calc(100vw - 32px), 460px);
            aspect-ratio: 1;
        }
        .monopoly-board {
            display:grid;
            grid-template-columns: 68px repeat(9,1fr) 68px;
            grid-template-rows: 68px repeat(9,1fr) 68px;
            width:100%; height:100%; gap:1px;
        }
        .board-cell {
            background:#FDF8F2; border:1px solid #E8D5C0;
            display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
            font-size:7px; text-align:center; position:relative; cursor:pointer;
            transition:transform 0.15s; padding:1px; overflow:hidden; border-radius:2px;
        }
        .board-cell:active { z-index:3; transform:scale(1.12); }
        .board-cell .cell-name { font-weight:600; font-size:7px; line-height:1.1; }
        .board-cell .cell-price { font-size:6px; color:var(--gold-dark); }
        .board-cell .cell-ico { font-size:11px; line-height:1; }
        .board-cell .cell-houses { position:absolute; top:1px; right:1px; font-size:5px; color:#8BA98B; }
        .board-cell .cell-players { display:flex; gap:1px; margin-top:1px; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; }
        .cell-tok { font-size:10px; line-height:1; }
        .board-cell.property-brown  { background:#F5EDE0; }
        .board-cell.property-blue   { background:#EDF0F4; }
        .board-cell.property-pink   { background:#F5EDF0; }
        .board-cell.property-orange { background:#F5F0E8; }
        .board-cell.property-red    { background:#F5E8E8; }
        .board-cell.property-green  { background:#ECF2EC; }
        .board-cell.property-yellow { background:#F5F2E4; }
        .board-cell.station  { background:#EDEFF2; }
        .board-cell.utility  { background:#EDF0F0; }
        .board-cell.start    { background:#ECF2EC; }
        .board-cell.jail, .board-cell.go-to-jail { background:#F5ECEC; }
        .board-cell.chance   { background:#F5F0E4; }
        .board-cell.fate     { background:#F5E8E4; }
        .board-cell.tax      { background:#F5ECF0; }
        .board-cell.parking  { background:#EDF0F2; }
        .board-cell[data-owner="0"] { border:2px solid #D4908A !important; }
        .board-cell[data-owner="1"] { border:2px solid #C9A96E !important; }
        .board-cell[data-owner="2"] { border:2px solid #9AA8B8 !important; }
        .board-cell[data-owner="3"] { border:2px solid #B0A0C0 !important; }

        /* 玩家列表（可滚动区域内） */
        .player-list {
            background:var(--card); border:2px solid var(--border); border-radius:14px;
            padding:8px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:5px;
            box-shadow:var(--shadow); flex-shrink:0;
        }
        .player-row {
            display:flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:6px 8px;
            border-radius:9px; background:var(--cream); border:2px solid var(--border); transition:all 0.25s;
        }
        .player-row.active-turn { border-color:var(--gold); background:#FFF8EC; }
        .player-row.bankrupt { opacity:0.4; }
        .player-row .pr-rank { font-size:12px; color:var(--gold-dark); min-width:16px; }
        .player-row .pr-av { width:28px; height:28px; border-radius:50%; overflow:hidden; flex-shrink:0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
        .player-row .pr-av img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; }
        .player-row .pr-info { flex:1; min-width:0; }
        .player-row .pr-name { font-size:11px; font-weight:700; }
        .player-row .pr-money { font-size:10px; color:var(--success); font-weight:600; }
        .player-row .pr-assets { font-size:9px; color:var(--text-dim); }

        /* 日志 */
        .game-log {
            background:var(--card); border:2px solid var(--border);
            border-radius:14px; padding:9px; box-shadow:var(--shadow); flex-shrink:0;
        }
        .game-log h4 { font-size:11px; color:var(--gold-dark); margin-bottom:5px; }
        .log-scroll {
            height:80px; overflow-y:auto; font-size:10px; line-height:1.7;
            color:var(--text-dim); border:1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius:6px; padding:4px 6px; background:var(--cream);
        }
        .log-entry { padding:1px 0; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(232,213,192,0.5); }
        .log-entry.imp { color:var(--gold-dark); font-weight:600; }
        .log-entry.bad { color:var(--danger); }

        /* ===== 底部固定区：操作栏 + 聊天 ===== */
        .game-bottom {
            flex-shrink: 0;
            border-top: 2px solid var(--border);
            background: var(--card);
            padding-bottom: env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px);
        }

        /* 操作栏 */
        .action-bar {
            display: flex; gap: 6px; padding: 7px 8px;
            align-items: center; flex-wrap: nowrap;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
            overflow-x: auto;
        }
        .action-bar::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
        .action-btn {
            padding:8px 12px; border-radius:20px; font-weight:600; font-size:12px;
            cursor:pointer; border:none; transition:all 0.25s; white-space:nowrap; flex-shrink:0;
        }
        .btn-primary { background:var(--gold); color:#fff; }
        .btn-secondary { background:var(--cream); color:var(--text); border:2px solid var(--border) !important; }
        .btn-danger { background:var(--danger); color:#fff; }
        .btn-items { background:#EDF2F7; color:var(--text); border:2px solid var(--border) !important; }
        .action-btn:disabled { opacity:0.35; cursor:not-allowed; }
        #dice-display { font-size:12px; color:var(--gold-dark); font-weight:600; white-space:nowrap; flex-shrink:0; }
        #wait-hint { font-size:10px; color:var(--text-dim); white-space:nowrap; flex-shrink:0; margin-left:auto; }

        /* 聊天区 */
        .chat-section { display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
        .chat-hdr {
            display:flex; justify-content:space-between; padding:5px 12px;
            font-size:11px; color:var(--gold-dark); font-weight:600;
            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }
        .chat-msgs {
            height: 56px; /* 固定高度，不随键盘变化 */
            overflow-y: auto;
            -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
            padding: 5px 12px;
            display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px;
            background: var(--cream);
        }
        .chat-msg { display:flex; gap:5px; align-items:flex-start; font-size:11px; }
        .chat-msg .cm-av { font-size:14px; flex-shrink:0; }
        .chat-msg .cm-av img { width:16px; height:16px; border-radius:50%; object-fit:cover; }
        .chat-msg .cm-bubble {
            background:var(--card); padding:3px 7px; border-radius:8px;
            color:var(--text-dim); max-width:90%; border:1px solid var(--border);
            word-break:break-all; font-size:11px;
        }
        .chat-input-row {
            display:flex; padding:5px 8px; gap:5px; align-items:center;
            background: var(--card);
        }
        /* font-size:16px 防 iOS 自动缩放 */
        .chat-input-row input {
            flex:1; padding:7px 10px; background:var(--cream);
            border:2px solid var(--border); border-radius:16px;
            color:var(--text); font-size:16px; outline:none; min-width:0;
            -webkit-user-select:text; user-select:text;
        }
        .chat-input-row input:focus { border-color:var(--gold); }
        .chat-input-row button {
            padding:7px 11px; border-radius:16px; font-size:11px;
            font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; border:none; flex-shrink:0;
        }
        .chat-send-btn { background:var(--gold); color:#fff; }
        .chat-api-btn { background:var(--cream); color:var(--gold-dark); border:2px solid var(--gold) !important; }

        /* ===== 弹窗系统 ===== */
        .overlay-base {
            display:none; position:fixed; top:0; left:0; right:0; bottom:0;
            background:rgba(74,55,40,0.55); z-index:200;
            justify-content:center; align-items:center;
            backdrop-filter:blur(3px); padding:16px;
        }
        .overlay-base.active { display:flex; }

        /* 通用弹窗卡片 */
        .action-popup {
            background:var(--card); border:2px solid var(--gold);
            border-radius:18px; padding:20px; max-width:300px; width:100%;
            text-align:center; box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
            animation:popIn 0.22s ease; position:relative;
            max-height: 80vh; overflow-y: auto;
        }
        .action-popup .ap-emoji { font-size:38px; margin-bottom:6px; }
        .action-popup .ap-title { font-size:14px; font-weight:700; color:var(--gold-dark); margin-bottom:6px; }
        .action-popup .ap-body { font-size:12px; color:var(--text-dim); line-height:1.7; white-space:pre-line; }
        .action-popup .ap-close {
            margin-top:12px; padding:7px 22px; background:var(--gold); color:#fff;
            border:none; border-radius:20px; font-size:13px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer;
        }
        .action-popup .ap-x {
            position:absolute; top:8px; right:10px; background:none; border:none;
            font-size:16px; cursor:pointer; color:var(--text-dim); padding:2px;
        }

        /* 骰子弹窗 */
        #dice-overlay { z-index:300; }
        .dice-box {
            background:var(--card); border:3px solid var(--gold);
            border-radius:20px; padding:24px 32px; text-align:center;
            box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
        }
        .dice-who { font-size:13px; color:var(--text-dim); margin-bottom:12px; }
        .dice-faces { display:flex; gap:14px; justify-content:center; margin-bottom:12px; }
        .dice-face {
            width:54px; height:54px; background:var(--cream); border:2px solid var(--gold);
            border-radius:12px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
            font-size:24px; font-weight:700; color:var(--gold-dark);
        }
        .dice-face.rolling { animation:diceRoll 0.08s infinite; }
        @keyframes diceRoll { 0%{transform:rotate(-10deg) scale(1.06)} 50%{transform:rotate(10deg) scale(0.94)} 100%{transform:rotate(-10deg) scale(1.06)} }
        .dice-sum { font-size:16px; font-weight:700; color:var(--gold-dark); margin-bottom:12px; }
        .dice-confirm {
            padding:8px 28px; background:var(--gold); color:#fff;
            border:none; border-radius:20px; font-size:13px; font-weight:700;
            cursor:pointer; display:none;
        }

        /* 道具弹窗 */
        #items-overlay { z-index:250; }
        .items-popup {
            background:var(--card); border:2px solid var(--gold);
            border-radius:18px; padding:18px; max-width:300px; width:100%;
            box-shadow:var(--shadow); animation:popIn 0.22s ease;
        }
        .items-popup h3 { color:var(--gold-dark); font-size:14px; margin-bottom:12px; text-align:center; }
        .items-grid { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; }
        .item-row {
            display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:10px;
            background:var(--cream); border:2px solid var(--border); border-radius:10px;
            cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.2s;
        }
        .item-row:hover, .item-row:active { border-color:var(--gold); }
        .item-row .item-ico { font-size:22px; }
        .item-row .item-info { flex:1; }
        .item-row .item-name { font-size:12px; font-weight:700; }
        .item-row .item-desc { font-size:10px; color:var(--text-dim); }
        .item-empty { text-align:center; font-size:12px; color:var(--text-dim); padding:16px 0; }
        .items-cancel {
            margin-top:10px; width:100%; padding:9px; background:transparent;
            color:var(--text-dim); border:2px solid var(--border);
            border-radius:18px; cursor:pointer; font-weight:600; font-size:13px;
        }

        /* 目标选择弹窗 */
        #target-overlay { z-index:260; }
        .target-card {
            background:var(--card); border:2px solid var(--gold);
            border-radius:14px; padding:18px; max-width:280px; width:100%; text-align:center;
        }
        .target-card h3 { color:var(--gold-dark); margin-bottom:10px; font-size:14px; }
        .target-opt {
            padding:8px; background:var(--cream); border:2px solid var(--border);
            border-radius:9px; cursor:pointer; font-size:12px;
            transition:all 0.2s; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:7px; margin-bottom:5px;
        }
        .target-opt:active { border-color:var(--gold); }

<!-- ==================== 设置界面 ==================== -->

      <select id="total-rounds">

        <option value="40">40回合（较长）</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="setting-group">
      <label>💰 初始资金</label>
      <select id="initial-money">
        <option value="20000" selected>20,000元（标准）</option>
        <option value="30000">30,000元</option>
        <option value="15000">15,000元（困难）</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="setting-group">
      <label>📊 结算频率</label>
      <select id="settle-freq">
        <option value="5">每5回合显示排名</option>
        <option value="10" selected>每10回合显示排名</option>
      </select>
    </div>
    <div class="step-card">
      <div class="step-title"><span class="step-num">1</span>选择陪你玩的角色</div>
      <p class="step-hint">选1~3个角色作为对手，系统会随机分配大富翁棋子给他们</p>
      <div class="picked-chars-row" id="picked-chars-row">
        <span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--text-dim);font-style:italic;">还没选对手，快去选~</span>
      </div>
      <div style="margin-top:8px;display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;">
        <button class="btn-pick" id="btn-pick-chars" onclick="pickOpponentChars()">＋ 选择角色</button>
        <span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--text-dim);" id="pick-count-hint">已选 0 位对手</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="step-card">
      <div class="step-title"><span class="step-num">2</span>选择你的棋子角色</div>
      <p class="step-hint">选一个作为你在棋盘上的代表</p>
      <div class="char-grid" id="char-grid-me"></div>
    </div>
    <button class="btn-start" id="btn-start" onclick="startGameSetup()" disabled>🚀 开始游戏</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ==================== 角色选择动画 ==================== -->
<div id="selection-screen" class="screen">

    <div class="sel-status" id="sel-status">🎲 分配角色中...</div>
    <div class="sel-avatars" id="sel-avatars"></div>
    <div class="sel-log" id="sel-log"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ==================== 游戏界面 ==================== -->
<div id="game-screen" class="screen">

    <div class="round-info">🎯 第<span id="cur-round">1</span>/<span id="max-rnd">25</span>回合</div>
    <div class="cur-disp">👤 <span id="cur-player-name">-</span></div>

  </div>

      <div id="board-container"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="player-list" id="player-list"></div>

    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="overlay-base" id="dice-overlay">

const sleep = ms => new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));
const rnd = (a,b) => Math.floor(Math.random()*(b-a+1))+a;
const getTotalAssets = p => {
    let a=p.money;
    p.properties.forEach(pr=>{const t=BOARD[pr.tileId];if(t){a+=t.price;a+=(t.houses||0)*(t.houseCost||500);}});
    return a;
};

// ==================== AI文本净化 ====================
function sanitizeAIText(raw) {
    if (!raw) return '';
    let text = raw;
    text = text.replace(/```[\s\S]*?```/g, '');
    text = text.replace(/`[^`]*`/g, '');
    text = text.replace(/\{[^{}]*\}/g, '');
    text = text.replace(/\[[^\[\]]*\]/g, '');
    text = text.replace(/\n{2,}/g, '\n').trim();
    const first = text.split('\n')[0].trim();
    return first.length > 60 ? first.substring(0,60) : first;
}

async function buildPlayers() {
    const logDiv=document.getElementById('sel-log');
    const avsDiv=document.getElementById('sel-avatars');
    logDiv.innerHTML='';avsDiv.innerHTML='';
    G.players=[];

    // 玩家自己选的棋子
    const myChar=ALL_CHARS.find(c=>c.id===G.playerCharId);
    G.players.push({
        ...myChar, isHuman:true, appAvatar:null,
        displayName: myChar.name, // 玩家显示名就是棋子名
        money:G.initialMoney, position:0,
        properties:[], inJail:0, bankrupt:false,
        freeParking:false, skipNextTurn:false, shieldActive:false, doubleNextRoll:false,
        items:randomItems(3),
    });
    selLog(logDiv,`✅ 你选择了 ${myChar.avatar} ${myChar.name}`);
    selChip(avsDiv,myChar.avatar,null,myChar.name,'你');
    await sleep(400);

    // 用于分配给对手的棋子（排除玩家已选的）
    const availableChars=ALL_CHARS.filter(c=>c.id!==G.playerCharId);
    const shuffled=[...availableChars].sort(()=>Math.random()-0.5);

    for(let i=0;i<G.opponentChars.length;i++){
        const ac=G.opponentChars[i];
        await sleep(500);
        // 分配一个棋子角色给这个对手
        const assignedChar=shuffled[i % shuffled.length];
        // 显示名：角色名（棋子名）
        const displayName=`${ac.name}（${assignedChar.name}）`;
        G.players.push({
            // 棋子属性（外观、策略、personality）
            ...assignedChar,
            // 覆盖 id 和 name，用 displayName 展示
            id: ac.id||('char_'+Math.random()),
            name: displayName,
            shortName: ac.name, // AI prompt 里用的简短名
            charTokenName: assignedChar.name, // 棋子名
            appAvatar: ac.avatar||null,
            isHuman: false,
            // AI 个性：完全使用原本人设，棋子只作为它在游戏里的皮肤/马甲
personality: ac.description ? ac.description : assignedChar.personality,
            money:G.initialMoney, position:0,
            properties:[], inJail:0, bankrupt:false,
            freeParking:false, skipNextTurn:false, shieldActive:false, doubleNextRoll:false,
            items:randomItems(3),
        });
        selLog(logDiv,`🎭 ${ac.name} 参战！操控棋子：${assignedChar.avatar} ${assignedChar.name}`);
        selChip(avsDiv,assignedChar.avatar,ac.avatar,displayName,'对手');
    }

    await sleep(400);
    G.players.sort(()=>Math.random()-0.5);
    selLog(logDiv,'🎲 随机出场顺序...');
    await sleep(600);
    G.players.forEach((p,i)=>selLog(logDiv,`${i+1}. ${p.name}`));
    await sleep(1000);

    document.getElementById('selection-screen').classList.remove('active');
    startGame();
}

// ==================== 棋盘渲染 ====================
function renderBoard() {
    const container=document.getElementById('board-container');
    const pos=[];
    for(let i=0;i<=9;i++) pos.push({idx:i,row:10,col:10-i});
    for(let i=11;i<=19;i++) pos.push({idx:i,row:10-(i-10),col:0});
    for(let i=0;i<=9;i++) pos.push({idx:20+i,row:0,col:i});
    for(let i=0;i<=9;i++) pos.push({idx:30+i,row:i,col:10});
    const grid=Array(11).fill(null).map(()=>Array(11).fill(null));
    pos.forEach(p=>{grid[p.row][p.col]=BOARD[p.idx];});
    let html='<div class="monopoly-board">';
    for(let r=0;r<11;r++){
        for(let c=0;c<11;c++){
            const tile=grid[r][c];
            if(!tile){html+='<div style="background:#FFFBF5;border-radius:2px;"></div>';continue;}
            const here=G.players.filter(p=>p.position===tile.id&&!p.bankrupt);
            let cls='board-cell';
            if(tile.colorClass) cls+=' '+tile.colorClass;
            if(tile.type==='chance') cls+=' chance';
            if(tile.type==='fate') cls+=' fate';
            if(tile.type==='tax') cls+=' tax';
            const ownerAttr=tile.ownerIdx>=0?`data-owner="${tile.ownerIdx%4}"` :'';
            const icoHtml=tile.ownerIdx>=0
                ?`<div class="cell-ico">🏠</div>`
                :(tile.emoji?`<div class="cell-ico">${tile.emoji}</div>`:'');
            const houseHtml=tile.houses>0
                ?`<div class="cell-houses">${'🏠'.repeat(Math.min(tile.houses,4))}</div>`:'';
            const playersHtml=here.length>0
                ?`<div class="cell-players">${here.map(p=>`<span class="cell-tok">${p.avatar}</span>`).join('')}</div>`:'';
            html+=`<div class="${cls}" ${ownerAttr} onclick="showTileDetail(${tile.id})">
                ${icoHtml}
                <div class="cell-name">${tile.name}</div>
                ${tile.price?`<div class="cell-price">¥${tile.price>=1000?(tile.price/1000).toFixed(1)+'k':tile.price}</div>`:''}
                ${houseHtml}${playersHtml}
            </div>`;
        }
    }
    html+='</div>';
    container.innerHTML=html;
}

function showTileDetail(tileId) {
    const t=BOARD[tileId];
    const owner=t.ownerIdx>=0?G.players[t.ownerIdx]:null;
    const here=G.players.filter(p=>p.position===tileId&&!p.bankrupt);
    let info='';
    if(t.type==='property'){
        info=`<b>购买价格：</b>¥${t.price.toLocaleString()}<br><b>建房费用：</b>¥${(t.houseCost||0).toLocaleString()}/栋<br><b>当前房屋：</b>${t.houses||0}栋<br><b>租金：</b>空¥${t.rent[0]} | 1栋¥${t.rent[1]} | 2栋¥${t.rent[2]} | 3栋¥${t.rent[3]} | 4栋¥${t.rent[4]}`;
    } else if(t.type==='station'){
        info=`<b>价格：</b>¥${t.price.toLocaleString()}<br><b>租金：</b>1站¥${t.rent[0]} 2站¥${t.rent[1]} 3站¥${t.rent[2]} 4站¥${t.rent[3]}`;
    } else if(t.type==='utility'){
        info=`<b>价格：</b>¥${t.price.toLocaleString()}<br><b>租金：</b>随机¥${t.rent[0]}~¥${t.rent[1]}`;
    } else if(t.type==='tax'){
        info=`<b>税额：</b>¥${(t.taxAmount||0).toLocaleString()}`;
    } else {info=t.desc||'';}
    if(owner) info+=`<br><br><b>🏠 地主：</b>${owner.name}`;
    if(here.length) info+=`<br><b>📍 当前：</b>${here.map(p=>p.name).join('、')}`;
    const labels={property:'地产',station:'车站',utility:'公用事业',tax:'税收',chance:'机会',fate:'命运',start:'起点',jail:'监狱','go-to-jail':'进监狱',parking:'免费停车'};
    document.getElementById('td-inner').innerHTML=`
        <div class="td-emo">${t.emoji||'🏠'}</div>
        <div class="td-name">${t.name}</div>
        <div class="td-type">${labels[t.type]||'特殊'}</div>
        <div class="td-info">${info}</div>
        <button class="td-close" onclick="closeTileDetail()">关闭</button>
    `;
    document.getElementById('tile-detail-overlay').classList.add('active');
}
